race.comment: JUDITH'S REVENGE (10) is as consistent as they come. Just missed the bob at Wagga first-up with a big gap back to third. Her partner in crime Cahill takes back over and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside. Clearly the one to beat. KENDALIA (11) is knocking on the door after a narrow second here last time when charging late. Brings honest local form, though he still has to turn placings into a win. KOOL KADE (2) beat JUDITH'S REVENGE at Wagga but now meets her 5.5 kg worse at the weights. Keeping safe. FAMOSO (1) finished second at Canberra Acton two runs back but didn't measure up last time over 1200m at Wyong, finishing back in seventh. Finds a nice race and can bounce back.
